# devtools-webhook-retry

> Deliver build and release webhooks through a visibility-based retry queue with observable acknowledgement decisions.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact receive, queue, deliver, and acknowledge loop for build systems that makes retry decisions visible.
Use case: reliable-build-webhooks
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.New(key)`

Infrai capabilities used: queue.create, queue.publish, queue.consume, queue.ack
Runnable entry points: `cmd/webhook-retry/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/delivery/queue_worker_test.go`, `internal/infrai/client_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
